name: Rouge Vinstage
original_name: ルージュ・ヴァンスタージュ
source:
Born 04/10/2032
A big sisterly sexy lady. She loves rumors and is always poking her nose into talks about love.
At her core she hates being alone.
She's good at moving her body, especially her gun skills.
